summary: Aurora Mobile Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the US-equivalent of a half-year report. The filing contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event; content is limited to balance sheet, equity, revenue-recognition and fair-value XBRL detail tags. As an ordinary periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, it falls outside special-situations categories. What to watch: any subsequent 6-K disclosing a strategic transaction, capital return or management change; none is signaled here, so no risk-arb angle applies.
